component.name: Proton Drive FS
component.summary: Mount Proton Drive as a local folder through FUSE

description.p: Proton Drive FS mounts Proton Drive as a local folder through FUSE. Files and folders are listed from Proton's metadata, and the bytes of a file download only when something opens it.

Remote changes reach the mount through Proton's event feed, which invalidates the affected directory listings and cached file content. Writes are buffered to a local temp file and uploaded to Proton in full when the file closes.
This is an early, unofficial project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Proton AG.
